shared_elements: relief carving of figures with incised linear detail
garment/costume rendered as parallel incised lines
justification: Both depict human figures in profile rendered in low relief with incised contour lines, and both use parallel incised lines to indicate garment or hair texture, but that is a very generic correspondence. A shows a single isolated bust-length head-and-shoulders figure filling a plaque in a highly schematic, flat, outline style, while B is a crowded naturalistic narrative of multiple bodies, chariots with spoked wheels, horses and swirling water, with no comparable relationships or arrangement.
